participants.title: Development team
participants.description: Maintains the EMIM and develops the surrounding tooling — ETL processes, schemapack, the EM Transformation Service, validators, and web components.

participants.title: Central Data Stewardship
participants.description: Coordinates GHGA Data Stewardship across the consortium.

participants.title: Data Hubs
participants.description: We invite each Data Hub to nominate up to three participants. Together, the nominees should cover two areas of experience: (1) supporting GHGA submissions locally, and (2) metadata collection outside of GHGA — from the local Core Unit context. How participants are distributed across these areas is up to each hub, as long as both areas are represented. Core Unit participants need not be members of the local GHGA team.

sessions.name: Welcome, introductions, and meeting framing
sessions.description: Welcome from the organisers, introductions among participants, and an overview of the meeting's structure and aims.

sessions.name: Core Unit Metadata Protocols (Part 1)
sessions.speaker: Léon Kuchenbecker (EKUT)
sessions.description: Each Data Hub presents the metadata ingest protocols in use at their Core Unit — schema, tooling, and how the structured nature of the metadata is leveraged for queryability, automated pipeline execution, and other downstream uses. 30 minutes per hub, including discussion.

sessions.name: Core Unit Metadata Protocols (Part 2)
sessions.speaker: Léon Kuchenbecker (EKUT)
sessions.description: Continuation of the Core Unit protocol presentations. 30 minutes per hub, including discussion.

sessions.name: Synthesis
sessions.description: An interactive session drawing themes across the six Core Unit presentations — points of overlap, areas of divergence, and implications for the EMIM.

sessions.name: The current GHGA EMIM
sessions.speaker: Paul Menges (DKFZ)
sessions.description: An overview of the current Experimental Metadata Ingress Model — its scope, structure, and role within GHGA submissions. Intended as common ground for the room, including Core Unit colleagues new to GHGA.

sessions.name: Experience with the GHGA EMIM
sessions.speaker: Paul Menges (DKFZ)
sessions.description: Each GHGA-experienced hub shares experiences and challenges encountered when supporting submissions through the current EMIM. Format: 10 minutes presentation + 5 minutes discussion per hub.

sessions.name: Reflection: Archive vs. Core Unit metadata needs
sessions.speaker: Léon Kuchenbecker (EKUT)
sessions.description: A joint reflection on how metadata needs differ between a data archive (such as GHGA) and a bioinformatics core facility, and what these differences imply for ingress model design.

sessions.name: New EM technologies in GHGA
sessions.speaker: Bilge Sürün (EKUT)
sessions.description: An overview of recent developments in GHGA's EM technology stack — schemapack, the EM Transformation Service (EMTS), and the architecture for metadata handling after the upcoming rollout — and a discussion of what new possibilities this opens up for EM structuring.

sessions.name: Data Submissions and Data Access Requests
sessions.speaker: Jan Eufinger
